description: Offline inventory and credit ledger for sari-sari stores

files.README.md:
# sari-ledger

An offline-first inventory and credit (utang) ledger for neighborhood sari-sari stores. Runs on a cheap Android phone through Termux and syncs to a small server when there is signal.

Records sales, restocks and customer credit, and prints a daily summary in Tagalog or English.
